detail.body:
- Remove `send_decode_id_offset`, `decoded_text` and `init_incremental_detokenize` from the request fake in `test_rust_server_extension.py`. The output streamer stopped reading them when the detokenizer took over decode state (#47260) and `decoded_text` was removed (#47249).

Test-only; no behavior change.
